name: Assei (external-verifier context engine)
description: OpenClaw extension. Binds to the `contextEngine` slot and uses the `afterTurn` hook to run an external verifier model via PluginRuntime.subagent — auto-continues the same OpenClaw session until the verifier reports DONE or BLOCKED.

model.description: REQUIRED. Verifier model id. Assei is an external verifier and must be pinned to a model independent of the main agent (e.g. 'openai/gpt-5-mini', 'apiclient/glm-5.1').
